name: DoorLoop
description: DoorLoop is a property management software platform designed to manage residential units, commercial spaces, student housing, and community associations with automated rent collection and full accounting.
best_for: Property managers, landlords, and real estate management companies with mixed or growing rental portfolios.
features: Automated online rent collection via ACH, credit card, and debit card
Comprehensive tenant screening with credit, criminal, and eviction reports
Complete double-entry accounting with bank reconciliation and QuickBooks sync
Maintenance request management with vendor dispatch and photo tracking
Dedicated owner portals with automated distributions and custom reports
Online tenant portal for lease signing, payments, and communication

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Up to 20 units; accounting, CRM, and rent collection.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Adds owner portal, tenant screening, and outgoing payments.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Adds open API access, custom website, and personalized onboarding.

pros: Extremely intuitive and modern user interface compared to legacy PM tools
Supports all property types (residential, commercial, HOA, storage) in one login
Built-in double-entry accounting eliminates mandatory third-party software
cons: No perpetual free plan; requires paid subscription after 14-day trial
Base price covers up to 20 units; per-unit pricing increases with portfolio scale
Advanced API access restricted to Premium tier

alternatives.name: AppFolio
alternatives.description: Enterprise property management platform with AI leasing and multi-family management.
alternatives.best_for: Portfolios with 50+ residential or commercial units

alternatives.name: Buildium
alternatives.description: RealPage property management software for residential portfolios and community associations.

alternatives.name: TenantCloud
alternatives.description: Affordable cloud property management and rent collection software for DIY landlords.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller DIY landlords seeking budget-friendly rental management
